Trusted Emergency and Specialty Veterinary Care in Central Los Angeles
24-7 ER
Committed to the highest standard of care, Metropolitan Animal Specialty Hospital delivers medical excellence with an exceptional pet and client experience.
Why
choose
MASH
Expertise you can trust
Our board-certified specialists and experienced emergency veterinarians deliver advanced, lifesaving care with precision and compassion—24/7.
Integrated team approach
Whether facing a critical emergency or managing a complex medical condition, our team works collaboratively across specialties to ensure the best possible outcome for every patient.
Locally owned & veterinarian-led
We are proud to be locally owned and operated by a dedicated team of veterinarians who are deeply invested in the health of our community’s pets.
Clear, continuous communication
We prioritize transparency and clarity in every interaction, keeping you and your family veterinarian informed, involved, and confident in the care plan.
More
We’re proud to offer both emergency and specialty veterinary care for your pet—all in one convenient location! With our team of board-certified specialists, you can trust that your pet is in expert hands. We collaborate closely with your pet’s family veterinarian to ensure seamless care and the best possible outcomes for your furry family members.
Specialty Care
At MASH, our board-certified specialists provide advanced care across multiple disciplines—including Internal Medicine, Surgery, Oncology, Dentistry, Dermatology, Neurology, and Ophthalmology. Our specialists work closely together and with your family veterinarian to ensure seamless, comprehensive care for your pet.
MORE
Emergency Care
MASH offers 24/7 Emergency and Critical Care—because pet emergencies can happen anytime. Our experienced emergency team is always on-site to provide immediate medical attention, advanced diagnostics, and life-saving treatment. No appointment is needed; we’re here for you and your pet, day or night.
